name: Hotel Kamp
positioning: Hotel Kämp, Helsinki's historic grand hotel, opened in 1887 and overlooking Esplanadi Park in the city center
best_for: Travelers who want a historic grand hotel on Esplanadi Park in central Helsinki
Guests who want a spa with Finnish saunas, a vitality pool and a cold plunge
Travelers bringing a dog or other pet

facts.text: Hotel Kamp opened in 1887 as Finland's first European-style grand hotel.
The hotel was built by restaurateur Carl Kamp, on the corner of Pohjoisesplanadi and Kluuvikatu streets.
The architect was Theodor Hoijer, whose other buildings include the Ateneum Art Museum a few streets away.
The building was Finland's first with a passenger elevator.
The hotel overlooks Esplanadi Park in the heart of Helsinki.
The hotel sits in the middle of Helsinki's shopping district, with designer shops, museums, the harbor and the city's main sights within walking distance.
A bank's headquarters occupied the site from 1969 until 1997, and Hotel Kamp was restored and reopened in 1999.
Kamp Spa has traditional Finnish, steam and infrared saunas, a vitality pool and a cold plunge.
Restaurant A La Kamp reworks the hotel's own archival menus through French technique and a Finnish eye for ingredients.
The A La Kamp menu includes traditional salmon soup, Toast Skagen, Chateaubriand and grilled lobster.
Kamp Bar is known for hand-crafted cocktails and a deep affection for champagne.
Kamp Delicatessen is a neighborhood deli by day and an intimate wine bar by night.

highlights.text: Jean Sibelius, Akseli Gallen-Kallela and other artists were such regulars that they named their own circle: the Symposium.
The Sibelius Suite has a grand piano, a kitchen, private sauna facilities and views over Esplanadi Park.
C.G.E. Mannerheim, Finland's wartime commander-in-chief and sixth president, stayed at the hotel for the entire summer of 1919.
The Mannerheim Suite has a private balcony, a kitchenette and a separate private entrance.
Some Executive Park View rooms feature an original tiled stove.

considerations.text: The hotel went through a comprehensive refurbishment in 2024-2026, staying open throughout, with full renovation completing in October 2026.
Smoking is not permitted inside the hotel building, only in designated outdoor areas.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
